properties.name: Waverly Lake
properties.status: Current source for Waverly, which sells water to Apple Creek. CyrusOne service is prospective.

properties.name: Otter Lake
properties.status: Proposed backup through Apple Creek; signed supply/funding terms and an operating connection were not established.

sites.name: Proposed CyrusOne campus
sites.status: Zoning approved; proposed campus, not an operating facility verified by this review
sites.address: Thayer Road / Clark Road, Talkington Township, Sangamon County
sites.detail: The four petition parcels total 280 acres. Waverly supplies Apple Creek today; service and funding terms for this future campus remain under review. Otter Lake is a proposed backup source, not a verified operating connection.
sites.locationQuality: County parcel geometry; campus marker is a representative point

sites.name: Memorial West Jefferson data center
sites.status: Data-center use documented by 2010; current physical operation not independently verified
sites.detail: Engineering material specifically identifies MHS Data Center at this address. Current Memorial IT recruiting also uses this building. No verified site power or water-demand comparison with CyrusOne is available.
sites.locationQuality: County address point; not a mapped server-room footprint

sites.name: State Central Computing Facility
sites.status: Existing facility named in the state’s FY2026 disaster-preparedness plan
sites.detail: State records identify this as the Central Computing Facility. It is distinct from the replacement project on Dotmar Drive. Capacity and utility demand are not inferred from this location.

sites.name: New State Central Computing Facility project
sites.status: Replacement project; May 2026 board record describes completed design, not verified opening
sites.detail: Capital Development Board project 250-000-020 identifies the site and a $145 million project budget. This marker does not establish construction completion or operation. State property records also use a 3000 E. Dotmar address for the computing-facility site; the map uses the project’s 2900 Dotmar address.
sites.locationQuality: County address point for the published project address

sites.name: LRS campus data center
sites.status: Historical data center documented by the operator; current on-site status not verified
sites.address: LRS campus, 2401 W. Monroe Street, Springfield
sites.detail: LRS’s 2017 campus history says Building 5 included a large data center when built in 1989. The marker is the published corporate-campus address, not a verified position of Building 5 or evidence of a current commercial colocation service.
sites.locationQuality: Approximate campus point; data-center building footprint not verified

sites.name: Hanson data / disaster-recovery center
sites.status: Operator confirms a data center; street address is self-reported in a business profile
sites.detail: Hanson’s current company history says its disaster-recovery/data center was completed in 2008. Its business profile identifies 426 W. Monroe as the separate facility. The address is mapped as a reported location pending direct current confirmation.
sites.locationQuality: County address point for a reported facility address

sites.name: UIS Health and Sciences data center
sites.status: Primary campus data center documented in the 2020 campus assessment
sites.address: Health and Sciences Building, 2295 William Maxwell Lane, Springfield
sites.detail: The university’s facilities assessment identifies HSB as its primary data center and University Hall as the redundant location. These are two buildings on one campus, not two hyperscale campuses. This review did not establish their present power demand or later changes.
sites.locationQuality: County point for the university’s published building address

sites.name: UIS University Hall backup data center
sites.status: Redundant campus data center documented in the 2020 campus assessment
sites.address: University Hall, 2180 Vachel Lindsay Drive, Springfield
sites.detail: The university’s facilities assessment identifies University Hall as its redundant data center. The pin locates the public building, not a room or equipment position. Current operation was not independently re-audited.
sites.locationQuality: County point for the university’s published building address

sites.name: Harris Computing Facility historical site
sites.status: State redundant computing site documented in 2008; current status not verified
sites.detail: A 2008 Capital Development Board bulletin identifies the Harris Computing Facility as a local redundant computing site at this address. This is retained as a historical reference, not a claim that it operates as a data center today.
sites.locationQuality: County address point for the historical state site

sites.name: State Police headquarters computing project
sites.status: 2010 data-center renovation project documented; completion and current use not verified
sites.address: State Police Central Headquarters, 801 S. Seventh Street, Springfield
sites.detail: A 2010 state bulletin proposed renovating a data center/computer room at Central Headquarters. An official ISP notice identifies the headquarters street address. A proposed renovation does not prove its completion; this pin is a historical project reference.
sites.locationQuality: Public headquarters address; historical project location only

coverage.limits: Public-source inventory, not a complete registry. No independently verified named facility location found in Morgan or Macoupin. Historical and reported records are not confirmed operating centers.
